title: Organic vs. Conventional Foods: Dr. Mercola’s Guide to Reducing Toxins in Your Diet
summary: Magazine piece relaying an alternative-health doctor's case for organic food to cut pesticide and GMO exposure and to gain nutrients.

assertions.quote: One of the main benefits of organic foods is they reduce your exposure to pesticides and other toxins.

verdicts.note: Several pesticides are endocrine disruptors at higher doses, but harm at typical dietary residue levels has not been shown.

assertions.quote: organic foods often have higher levels of important nutrients, antioxidants, and vitamins
organic foods often have higher levels of important nutrients, antioxidants, and vitamins, making them safer and more nutrient-dense
making these foods a more sustainable choice for the environment
Organic foods are also free from GMOs, which Dr. Mercola warns could have long-term health consequences.

verdicts.note: Major scientific reviews find no evidence that approved GE foods pose greater health risks than conventional foods.
